Home Brewed Ginger Tea
By: Køkken69
Published: Tuesday, February 16, 2010 - 3:59pm

Ingredients




100 grams Fresh ginger, thinnly sliced
1 1/2 litres         Water

Preparation

1 Combine ingredients in medium saucepan, bring to a boil. 2 Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered about 15mins or until liquid has reduced by a third. 3 Cool 5 mins and strain. (for those who are unaccustomed to the spiciness of ginger, a tsp of honey can be added to sweeten)

About


Home brewed ginger tea - the trusted aid to detox and relieve bloatedness and indigestion
